How do I use SMART data on Windows 7 or 8 (both 64-bit)? Do I just need a special program? Or do I need to set something up in the OS or BIOS?

How do I use SMART data on Windows 7 or 8 (both 64-bit)? Do I just need a special program? Or do I need to set something up in the OS or BIOS?

SMART-capable HDDs are always recording data on their own performance, keeping track of many statistics related to performance on the drive. You don't need to enable anything for it to work, normally, but you do need software if you want to view the detailed data. On Windows, I prefer Speccy, because I love Piriform software and its "Storage" section will report your SMART status and a ton of other useful data for troubleshooting.

IMPORTANT: While the drive is indexing and you can hear general activity, the drive does have a click of death. In other words, it is living on borrowed time and will die completely at any time.

Back up your data immediately and then get the drive replaced.
